input: Research remote cabin rentals for a digital detox weekend

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Whether this is a solo trip, a couple's retreat, a friend group, or a family changes the cabin size, sleeping arrangements, and amenities needed.
The departure location determines which regions and travel distances are realistic for a weekend trip.
Budget per night (or total) directly filters which rental platforms and cabin tiers are worth researching.
Knowing what 'digital detox' means to this person — no Wi-Fi only, or fully off-grid with no electricity — determines which cabin features to seek or avoid.
Preferred natural setting (mountains, forest, lakeside, desert) shapes which regions and listings to prioritise.
Knowing the target weekend or date range is essential for checking availability and comparing real prices.
Understanding what the ideal output looks like — a shortlist of links, a comparison table, a single top pick — defines how deep and wide the research needs to go.

gold.taskTitle: Research remote cabin rentals for a digital detox weekend
gold.taskDescription: Find and evaluate remote cabin rental options suitable for an intentional offline, screen-free weekend getaway.

questions.title: How many people are going on this trip?
questions.description: Establish the group size to determine the required cabin capacity and sleeping arrangements.

questions.title: What city or region will you be departing from?
questions.description: Identify the starting location to set a realistic driving or travel radius for a weekend trip.

questions.title: What is your total budget for the rental?
questions.description: Capture the nightly or total spend limit to filter cabin options appropriately.

questions.title: What does 'digital detox' mean for you specifically?
questions.description: Clarify whether the goal is simply no Wi-Fi, a fully off-grid cabin, no cell signal, or something else — this determines which features to seek or avoid.

questions.title: What natural setting or landscape do you prefer?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants mountains, dense forest, lakeside, desert, or is open to any — this shapes which regions to research.

questions.title: Do you have a specific weekend or date range in mind?
questions.description: Pin down the travel dates so availability and pricing can be checked accurately.

questions.title: What should the final research output look like?
questions.description: Establish whether the user wants a ranked shortlist, a comparison table, a single top recommendation, or something else — defines the depth and format of research needed.
